_about: Supabase Auth settings, applied by apply.py (README.md). Names and non-secret values only: each secret is named by the environment variable that supplies it at run time, from Doppler. Staging and production share every setting except the addresses and the hourly email limit; each environment's project is in infra/supabase/project/settings.json. No `vercel.app` address is ever allowed, because anyone can create one: previews sign in through staging's signed relay (`/auth/relay`, product/web/lib/auth-relay.ts). The app's way back from Google is its own exact address (`hrizzup://auth/callback`, never a pattern), which only the app opens; the sign-in it carries is useless without the verifier only the app holds (PKCE). The sign-in methods that are on are exactly the *_enabled switches set to true here; apply.py fails if any other is on.

production._note: rate_limit_email_sent (emails an hour, whole project) is raised before launch to fit expected sign-ups. The app's way back from Google (hrizzup://auth/callback, staging's since step 1.6b) joins uri_allow_list when the app first uses production (runbook, pre-launch checklist, P.14).
